note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Start the age readers once the ledger lands", the age rules reaching young writers, producers and directors as well as performers; "It should cover across every country"; "Again I want depth covering every basis for every feature leaving NO STONE UNTURNED"): what age changes for screen work in British Indian Ocean Territory: the age of majority, the working age, how a minor's contract binds and what of the pay is set aside, a child performer's permit and hours, the unions', the funds' and the company law's ages. Research, retry and web-search subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-ages-roles.md, BRIEF-ages-world.md, BRIEF-ages-search.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: The Territory has no law of its own on a minor's contracts: subject to its own specific laws, the law applied is the law of England as in force in England from time to time, so far as applicable to local circumstances; so a minor's contract for creative or performing work follows England's rules (see GB). Earnings set-aside: likewise England's (none in statute).

value.law: law of England as from time to time in force, Courts Ordinance 1983 s. 3(1)
value.qualification: only so far as applicable and suitable to local circumstances

sources.said: the law to be applied as part of the law of the Territory shall be the law of England as from time to time in force in England and the rules of equity as from time to time applied in England: Provided that the said law of England shall apply in the Territory only so far as it is applicable and suitable to local circumstances, and shall be construed with such modifications, adaptations, qualifications and exceptions as local circumstances render necessary.

figures.finding: The Territory's Employment Ordinance covers health and safety, trade disputes and employers' insurance, medical care and repatriation duties, and has no rule on children's work; England's law applies so far as applicable to local circumstances, but England's child-performance licences are issued by a local authority, which the Territory hasn't, so how (or whether) a licence could be had there isn't settled by any text read. There is no resident civilian population, only around 2,000 military personnel, officials and contractors.

value.population: about 2,000 on Diego Garcia, mostly military personnel, officials and contractors
